recommendations.rationale: Telemetry freshness hardening must precede broader canary expansion to keep verification signal quality stable.
impacts: Reduces stale runtime signals during autonomous canary validation.
Improves confidence in downstream rollout decisions.

recommendations.rationale: Cross-project runtime canary alignment is required before widening rollout in the target project.
impacts: Synchronizes runtime stabilization checkpoints across projects.
Prevents rollout drift between target and peer runtime teams.

risks.summary: Rollout timing may drift between target and peer runtime projects.
risks.mitigation: Require a shared runtime checkpoint review before rollout widening.

risks.summary: Telemetry freshness can regress during canary windows if checks are not hardened.
risks.mitigation: Enforce freshness gate checks in each canary cycle before progression.
